title: golgi: open-source software for automated nerve model generation and recruitment simulation
description:
golgi is an open-source platform that takes a peripheral nerve from image to stimulated fiber population through a single graphical interface, with an equivalent scriptable Python API and command-line interface. It integrates promptable image segmentation, automated multi-region tetrahedral meshing (TetGen/Gmsh), anisotropic finite-element solution of the extracellular field with an explicit perineurium contact impedance (FEniCSx/DOLFINx), generation of realistic fiber populations and three-dimensional trajectories, and biophysical activation thresholds through interchangeable backends (NEURON via PyFibers; optional AxonML GPU surrogate). Every study exports as an integrity-hashed, self-contained bundle whose provenance is verified with golgi replay.

This release (v1.1.0) accompanies the revised SoftwareX article. It adds a Docker image (Dockerfile + archived image tarball), a pinned conda environment with platform lock files, continuous integration (GitHub Actions), an expanded test suite including an end-to-end regression test against recorded reference results, a per-stage benchmark script, and corrected API/CLI examples.
